# TradeVault

> A trading journal with a built-in AI coach. Log your trades, get your real
> patterns named, follow a plan and hold your discipline.

TradeVault is a web application for retail and prop-firm traders. It records
each trade, computes performance analytics from that record, and runs an AI
coach ("Jarvis") over the trader's own history — never over generic advice.

Site language: English by default (`/`), French at `/fr`. The application
interface supports twelve languages once signed in.

## What it does

- **Trading journal** — log a trade (symbol, direction, risk, R-multiple, setup,
  mistakes, screenshot) in well under a minute. CSV import from a broker is
  supported and structured automatically.
- **AI coach (Jarvis)** — reads the trader's own history, names recurring
  patterns (losing streaks, over-trading, the costliest leak) and proposes a
  concrete next step. It analyses the user's data; it does not give generic
  trading advice.
- **Quantitative analytics** — edge per setup, average R-multiple, day-of-week
  breakdown, drawdown, monthly target, equity curve.
- **Economic calendar** — macro releases with impact level and
  previous/forecast values.
- **Pre-market checklist** — a daily ritual to avoid impulse entries.
- **Goals and trading plan** — a progressive plan with tracked milestones.
- **Discipline notifications** — alerts when the trader breaks one of their own
  rules.
- **Multi-account** — prop, demo and live accounts side by side.

## What it is not

- It is not a broker and never connects to a brokerage account.
- It does not place, copy or signal trades.
- It does not provide financial advice. Nothing in the product is a
  recommendation to buy or sell.
- It does not guarantee any trading result.

## Pricing

Three plans, billed in euros:

- **Free** — €0, no time limit and no credit card. Journal, dashboard, equity
  curve, economic calendar, pre-market checklist and trading plan.
- **Pro** — €15 / month, or €120 / year. Adds the Jarvis AI coach, CSV import,
  advanced quantitative analytics and automatic monthly reports.
- **Elite** — €25 / month, or €200 / year.

Plans and prices come from the product catalogue and may change; the pricing
section of the home page is authoritative.

## Data and privacy

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Payments are handled by Stripe;
TradeVault never sees card details. A user can delete their account and all
associated data at any time. Full detail on the privacy page below.

Everything else on the domain sits behind authentication and is marked
`noindex`: dashboards, settings, the journal itself, conversations with the
coach and private reports. Please do not present those URLs as public pages.
